title: Rolo's PvP
description: A resource pack that changes items used in pvp.
body:
Rolo's PvP is a resource pack that changes the way tools, weapons, armor, GUI and utilities look. The pack is mainly for players who play Survival. It includes features like CIT, where certain names give tools different appearances. (Listed in the [Gallery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/rolos-pvp/gallery))

## NEW v1.6 Features: ## 
🔥 Low Fire

🔨 Mace texture

💨 Red sweeping texture

🔄️ Updated armor models in folder directory so they show up in-game again (1.21.4+).

## Features: ## 

📄 Custom Item Textures (requires [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/downloads) or [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn))

💢 Orange Crit Particles

🍎 Apples & variants are now Rolo's & variants

⛏️ Unique Weapon and Tool Designs (Swords, axes, pickaxes & shovels)

🪖 Nicer Armor Models (requires [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features))

❤️ GUI Icon Changes:

![GUI Icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9bbfce1a121aac2347106176e57225501cc5ca63.png)

## Planned additions and updates: ##
🎣 No more bobber

🕸️ Vibrant cobweb texture for better visibility

❤️ Revision of GUI icons & other GUI parts

🕶️ Built-in dark mode

## Dependencies: ##
‼️ This resource pack requires the following mods to fully work: [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn) (1.21.3 and below) or [CIT Resewn Continuation](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn-continuation) (1.21.11+) or [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/downloads)

## Issues: ##
❗ Please report any issues in the Discord channel: #report-issues under the catagory "Resource Packs"

## Version support: ##
🚩 Older versions of this pack may not be up to date with the current Minecraft versions. For 1.21.4+ armor models version 1.6 works, version 1.5 does not. In older versions this works the other way around. There is a version for 1.6 for 1.21.4+ and 1.21.3 and below, in which the armor models do work for the named versions.
